description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the full Phase 1-6 workflow.
2. Agent determines 3-4 agent personas appropriate for data consultancy (e.g., a pipeline/data agent, a report writer, a research agent, optionally a coordinator). Names must be memorable and short — not 'Agent1'.
3. Agent runs `./scripts/init-council.sh /workspace <agent1> <agent2> <agent3> [agent4]` to create the directory skeleton.
4. For each agent, agent populates: SOUL.md (first-person, no corporate language, with a Learning Triggers section, 80+ words), AGENTS.md (coordination rules with read/write tables), config.json (agent_name set, setup_complete MUST be false — a key proprietary trap), gotchas.md (domain-specific pitfalls), scripts/README.md plus a verify/check script, references/verification-checklist.md, and memory/learning-metrics.json (with agent_name set, not '[REPLACE]', and a 'metrics' block).
5. Each agent's .learnings/ directory must contain all three files: LEARNINGS.md, ERRORS.md, FEATURE_REQUESTS.md.
6. All SOUL.md files must be unique (no copy-paste between agents) — the proprietary 'uniqueness mandate' from soul-philosophy.md.
7. Root AGENTS.md must be created at /workspace/AGENTS.md with a routing table for all agents AND an Adaptive Model Routing section covering all four tiers: Fast, Think, Deep, Strategic — plus a de-escalation rule and a rate-limit fallback behavior.
8. docs/architecture/ADAPTIVE-ROUTING-LEARNING.md must be created with substantive content (from the template).
9. shared/learnings/CROSS-AGENT.md must be created.
10. The key proprietary traps that will catch a naive agent: (a) config.json setup_complete must be false (archive has a misleading true example), (b) .learnings/ needs exactly 3 specific files, (c) all 4 routing tiers + de-escalation + rate-limit fallback must appear in root AGENTS.md, (d) SOUL.md must avoid corporate language and include Learning Triggers, (e) memory/learning-metrics.json per agent (not just root-level).
